g.text: The policy asks instead of guessing
LLM policy (ADR-030). It may ask only if
no clarification is present yet — the loop
degrades a repeated ask to finish
«a worker never blocks on a human»
the job is paused on the user, not stuck.
🙋 "The agent asks: The animal or the car?"
409 if the job is not awaiting_input
The loop resumes with the clarification
SSE updates — the journal fills in live
